destinymod.configuration.title: Example Mod Configs
tooltip.destinymod.keyword.scorch.title: Scorch
tooltip.destinymod.keyword.scorch.desc:
The target is singed by destructive <keyword_solar:Solar> Light, taking damage over time. Damage increases as the target accumulates more <keyword_solar:Scorch> stacks.

After enough <keyword_solar:Scorch> stacks are applied to the target, they <keyword_solar:Ignite>.
tooltip.destinymod.keyword.ignition.desc: A large <keyword_solar:Solar> explosion which deals damage in an area around the target.
tooltip.destinymod.throwing_hammer.title: THROWING HAMMER
tooltip.destinymod.throwing_hammer.desc: Throw a hammer forged from <keyword_solar:Solar> Light which <keyword_solar:scorches> targets. Picking up <ability:Throwing Hammer> refunds melee energy.
tooltip.destinymod.thermite_grenade.desc: Explodes into a burning wave of <keyword_solar:scorching> fire which pulses multiple times.
tooltip.destinymod.melting_point.title: MELTING POINT
tooltip.destinymod.melting_point.desc:
While <keyword_solar:Sol Invictus> is active, <ability:Throwing Hammer> inflicts targets with <keyword_solar:Melting Point>.

Targets affected by <keyword_solar:Melting Point> take more damage from all sources, and the threshold to trigger an <keyword_solar:Ignition> is reduced.
tooltip.destinymod.heatseeker.title: HEATSEEKER
tooltip.destinymod.heatseeker.subtitle: Sunbreaker Aspect
tooltip.destinymod.heatseeker.desc: <ability:Throwing Hammer> homes in on targets and applies significantly more <keyword_solar:Scorch>.
tooltip.destinymod.anvil_drop.title: ANVIL DROP
tooltip.destinymod.anvil_drop.subtitle: Sunbreaker Aspect
tooltip.destinymod.anvil_drop.desc:
<ability:Throwing Hammer> is much slower and heavier, but deals significantly more damage. 

<ability:Throwing Hammer> hits trigger a small <keyword_solar:Solar> explosion which grows stronger based on its falling velocity.
tooltip.destinymod.rekindled_flames.desc: <ability:Thermite Grenades> pulse faster and travel farther. Damaging <keyword_solar:Scorched> targets adds additional pulses to the grenade.
tooltip.destinymod.sol_invictus.title: SOL INVICTUS
tooltip.destinymod.sol_invictus.subtitle: Sunbreaker Passive
tooltip.destinymod.sol_invictus.desc:
Final blows from <keyword_solar:Solar> abilities and defeating <keyword_solar:scorched> targets has a chance to create a <keyword_solar:Sunspot>. Your abilities regenerate faster while standing in a <keyword_solar:Sunspot>. 

<keyword_solar:Sunspots> damage targets inside and apply <keyword_solar:Scorch>.
death.attack.destinymod.sunspot: %1$s was engulfed in the corona of %2$s
